📣 Partner visa renewal coming up? Get a 2-year visa this time! 📣

Last week, PIBA made a major update to the partner visa procedures, and today, international couples are already receiving 2-year partner visas valid until 2028!

As usual, AIC has published a full breakdown of all the changes and what they mean for international couples on our website. If you don't follow AIC or subscribe to our updates, you're missing important information about your rights!

So if you have an upcoming visa renewal appointment (from your second visa in the process and onward), don't hesitate to raise the recent procedure update during your appointment and ask to be considered for a 2-year visa renewal.
--

Advocacy works! AIC pushed for this change over and over in the parliament now it's finally happening!
